Container.Name: mcp-obsidian
Container.Overview: Unraid Docker template for the MCP-server for Obsidian. Connects your local Obsidian Vault to AI agents like Open WebUI, Claude, or Gemini via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Requires the Local REST API community plugin installed and running inside Obsidian on the same network. Self-built multi-arch image, daily rebuild from upstream MarkusPfundstein/mcp-obsidian.
Container.Changes: ### v1.0.0 - Initial release - Self-built multi-arch image (amd64 + arm64) published to ghcr.io/junkerderprovinz/mcp-obsidian - Daily automated build from upstream MarkusPfundstein/mcp-obsidian - Tested with Open WebUI as MCP tool server

Config.Name: Obsidian API Key
Config.Description: API key generated by the Local REST API community plugin in Obsidian. Find it under Settings -> Local REST API.

Config.Name: Obsidian Host URL
Config.Description: URL of the machine running Obsidian with the Local REST API plugin active. Change 192.168.1.50 to the actual IP of that machine. Default plugin port is 27124.

Config.Name: MCP Server Port
Config.Description: Port the MCP server listens on. Point your AI client (Open WebUI: Admin Settings -> Tools -> Manage Tool Servers) to http://<container-ip>:9999
